text:
Amira Hassan: Heads up — payroll marked the observed Eid holiday as Monday (30 Mar) for our EMEA calendar, but our Dublin office observed it on Friday (27 Mar). Two people ended up charged for a holiday + an approved day off. Can we make a one-off carryover or comp day?
Lea Chen: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Is this the folks who booked a WFH day that overlapped the observed holiday?
Amira Hassan: Yep — two ICs in Dublin had the WFH day already approved. The payroll export used a regional mapping that shifted the date.
Carlos Ruiz: That mapping comes from the regional holiday feed we pull. There was a late update from vendor.
Samir Patel: For clarity: are they asking to roll the day into next year's carryover, or to give a comp day this quarter?
Amira Hassan: Prefer comp day this quarter if possible — they had planned coverage and we don't want negative morale during sprint wrap.
Lea Chen: Policy excerpt: `Company-observed public holidays that differ from statutory local observance are normally not eligible for carryover. Exceptions possible in case of vendor/calendar errors or payroll mismatches; requires manager + People Ops approval.` Link: https://intranet.redwood/pto#observed-holidays
Carlos Ruiz: Technically we can fix payroll retro and mark one of the days as company-observed — that'll credit them the holiday back instead of modifying carryover. Payroll Bot, can we do a retro adjustment for two headcounts for 27 Mar -> 30 Mar mapping?
Payroll Bot: @Carlos Ruiz noted. Please submit payroll adjustment ticket with employee IDs and manager approval. Template: `#payroll-adjust: eid, date_observed=2027-03-27, date_recorded=2027-03-30, reason=holiday-feed-mismatch`
Samir Patel: I'm on it. Approving for both people. I'll paste IDs in the ticket now. :thumbsup:
Amira Hassan: Thanks Samir. Should People Ops log this as a one-off exception so we have audit trail?
Lea Chen: Yes — I'll file the exception record after payroll confirms the retro. We'll mark it as 'holiday-feed vendor mismatch' and set policy tag `audit:observed-holiday-exception`.
HR-Bot: Exception recorded (ID EXC-20270330-42). Payroll adjustment pending.
Carlos Ruiz: We'll also patch the holiday feed mapping for EMEA to avoid repeats; ETA EOD tomorrow.
Amira Hassan: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Sending the two folks a note now.
Samir Patel: FYI for timeline: payroll retro should reflect in next payroll run, but PTO balances updated immediately after payroll process completes. I'll follow up in this thread when done.
Payroll Bot: Payroll ticket created (PT-98765). Status: awaiting manager confirmation.
Lea Chen: Closing loop: once payroll marks complete, People Ops will update the PTO ledger and add the exception entry. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
